title: Implement Robust Request Body Parsing
description: This feature matters as it enables yantraverse to handle various request body formats, such as JSON, URL-encoded, and multipart/form-data, which is essential for building robust and versatile APIs. It will provide a simple and efficient way to parse request bodies, improving overall performance and security. This feature will also include error handling and logging mechanisms to ensure production readiness.
acceptance: The feature is accepted when all test cases pass, and the request body is correctly parsed for different formats, with proper error handling and logging.
reason: Implementing robust request body parsing is a high-impact feature that solves real problems, such as handling different request body formats, and improves performance, making it essential for a production-ready framework like yantraverse.
